correctness.rationale: For every odd prime power q and nonconstant affine step uT+v, u≠0, invertible coordinates (a,b)↔(x=D0/u²,y=D1/u²) yield the third discriminant z=2y−x+2. Irreducible monic quadratics correspond to all three discriminants being nonzero nonsquares. Expanded quadratic-character weight W=(1−χ(x))(1−χ(y))(1−χ(z)), proved the pairwise terms vanish, computed triple sum q and removed weighted zero-line union 3q−3, giving 8N=(q−1)(q−3). All boundaries, including q=3 zero, follow. Independent direct square-set enumeration for all nonzero-slope h over F_3,F_5,F_7,F_11,F_13 and independently implemented GF_9 matched 0,1,3,10,15,6 per shift. Finite tests corroborate, not replace, the character-sum proof.
